properties.description: Built 2026-10-23, PR A2. In objections_within, an objection (statement_kind objection, taken_as_given true) with no pinned source stands — "contested by an objection nobody has sourced" — so a step it attacks reads objected `contested` and the step's conclusion contested through it, never defeated, failed or refuted. Measured on the four colour fixture: as exported, S1 (pinned) DOCUMENTS Heawood's objection, so Kempe's degree-5 step reads defeated under both rules; with the documenting edges removed (the state the finding describes) 0.90.0 read defeated and this build reads contested; drawing a pinned DOCUMENTS back reads defeated.
properties.name: An objection taken as given that no pinned source documents contests what it attacks and never defeats or refutes it; once a pinned source documents it, the defeat rule applies
